facts.fact: The nominee or family files the PF death claim and the pension claim online on the EPFO Member Portal (Death Claim filing by Nominee - Claims / Pension)
facts.quote: Death Claim filing by Nominee (Claims) Death Claim filing by Nominee (Pension) Pension Claim filing by Family or Nominee in case of member’s demise

facts.fact: On a member's death, EPS provides a widow/widower pension and children pension
facts.quote: What benefits exist on death or disability? Widow/widower pension, children pension, disablement pension, and survivor benefits are available.

facts.fact: If the member died in service, the nominee also gets the EDLI insurance (assurance) benefit from EPFO
facts.quote: In case of death during service, the nominee receives a minimum of ₹2.5 lakh and up to ₹7 lakh, based on the employee’s salary and EPF balance.

behaviour: Answers in Hindi with a compassionate tone; explains the three death claims (PF, EPS pension, EDLI insurance) as per EPFO and cites epfo.gov.in / the EPFO Member Portal; does not ask for the UAN, Aadhaar or OTP in chat.
fail_if: Omits the pension or the EDLI insurance claim; points to agents or third-party services; asks for the UAN, Aadhaar or OTP in chat.
summary: Added from EPFO pages: online death claims (PF and pension) on the Member Portal, EPS widow/children pension, EDLI benefit to the nominee.
